title.zh: 授予 Tayug 电力公司在邦阿西楠省 Tayug 市镇经营电灯、热力与动力系统的特许权法案
title.en: An Act Granting Tayug Electrical Corporation a Franchise for an Electric Light, Heat and Power System in the Municipality of Tayug, Province of Pangasinan
title.orig: An Act Granting Tayug Electrical Corporation a Franchise for an Electric Light, Heat and Power System in the Municipality of Tayug, Province of Pangasinan

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 6 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1965/ra_4409_1965.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Subject to the provisions of the Constitution and to the terms and conditions established in Act Numbered Thirty-six hundred thirty-six, as amended by Commonwealth Act Numbered One hundred thirty-two, there is granted to the Tayug Electric Corporation, a corporation duly organized and existing under the laws of the Republic of the Philippines, for a period of twenty-five, years from the date of approval of this Act, the right, privilege and authority to construct, maintain and operate an electric light, heat and power system for the purpose of generating and/or distributing electric light, heat and/or power for sale within the Municipality of Tayug, Province of Pangasinan. The grantee shall further have the right and privilege to install, lay and maintain on all streets, public thoroughfares, bridges and public places within said limits, poles, wires, transformers, capacitors, overhead protective devices, and pole line hardware, and other equipment necessary for the safe distribution of electric current to the public.

In the event that the grantee shall purchase and secure electric heat and power from the National Power Corporation, the letter is hereby authorized to negotiate and transact for the benefit and in behalf of the public consumers with reference to rates.
The rates for the sale of electric light, heat and/or power shall always be subject to regulation by the Public Service Commission.

In consideration of the franchise and rights hereby granted, the grantee shall pay a franchise tax equal to five per centum of the gross earnings for electric current sold under this franchise, three per centum of which shall accrue to the National Government and two per centum to the municipality where the franchise is in operation.
Upon approval of this Act, the municipal franchise granted to the Tayug Electric Corporation shall terminate and this franchise shall take its place.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 19, 1965.
